client: remove the old Fetch helper
-- expect --
medium+
-- base/pkg/client/client.go --
package client

// Fetch gets a document by ID. Deprecated: use Get.
func Fetch(id string) (Doc, error) { return Get(id) }

// Get gets a document by ID.
func Get(id string) (Doc, error) { return Doc{ID: id}, nil }
